name: Natsukera! ~Natsuki ni Kerashi Shirotae no ♂~
original_name: なつけら！～ナツキにけらし白妙の♂～
source:
It was an early summer afternoon that the young girl came to my house. 
Her father had passed, and she was now living out here with relatives. 
Her name was Natsuki. 
Petite, with soft skin and hair, she was the sort of cute that nobody could deny. 
One thing, however, was odd about her. 
I don't know if it was good or bad... 
But it was something I couldn't ignore. 

Natsuki was not actually a girl. 

Love with an otoko no ko!? ADV game.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098934.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
初夏的一个午后，那个年轻女孩来到了我家。
她的父亲去世了，如今要和亲戚住在这里。
她名叫夏希。
娇小的身材、柔软的皮肤与秀发，是谁都无法否认的可爱。
不过，她身上有件事很奇怪。
我不知道那是好是坏……
但我无法视而不见。

夏希其实不是女孩。

这是一款与男孩子相爱的ADV游戏！

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098934.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
